match: ^'([^']+)' is already declared in the upper scope
samples: 'inner' is already declared in the upper scope on line 7 column 26.
what: A new variable uses a name that already exists in an outer scope. The inner variable hides the outer one.

street.headline: `{1}` don already dey for outside scope
street.happen: You create `{1}` inside, but `{1}` already dey for the outer scope. The new one hide the old one, so e easy to read the wrong value.
street.todo: Rename the inner one, or reuse the outer one if that na wetin you want.
street.learn: "shadow" mean say one name hide another name wey get the same name.

normal.headline: `{1}` don already dey for the outer scope
normal.happen: You declared `{1}` again inside a nested scope. It hides the outer `{1}`, which can make the code read the wrong value.
normal.todo: Rename the inner one, or reuse the outer one if that na wetin you want.
normal.learn: "shadow" mean say one name hide another name wey get the same name.
